## Problem and resulting change

Link the Issue and relevant requirement/decision IDs. State what changes for a contributor or visitor.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Remaining gaps

Describe unverified behavior, compatibility limits or follow-up work. Foundation checks do not establish application/public-release readiness.
